author: ViceTechnicolour
body:
This is a 2 team - 2 wool CTW map made by EDJM9 and ViceWatercolour. It is for dev_rev's contest, and it contains both Red and Blue wools as well as Purple and Orange wools. There are defense supplies in spawn, as well as scaling routes and a ring-like layout to complement the gameplay.

Images: http://imgur.com/a/uMjyQ (narrated)
XML: https://pastebin.com/UEw654D3
Download: http://www.mediafire.com/file/29ljw3bpapb5j7u/EDJM3.rar

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
Hey!

- Tunneling shouldn't be an issue, it is 4 blocks deep and I don't really want much tunneling in the gameplay of the map. I want the surface to be used as much as possible, as I put a few bedrock walls in as well. That one was intended.

- The middle I think is fine, but if you suggest on expanding it, which way do you believe it should expand? Should it change shape, or what should it be like? I thought having it in the dimensions of front lines and its width would be sufficient, since that's what some OCN maps do and play fine.

- The wool room island I couldn't make much bigger, but maybe if we want to do lanes or something leading up to the wool room like RFV, we could do something like that so there's more room for defenders.

- I agree with the random buttons: but there's only a few, I tried not to place buttons on stone brick. I'll fix that, and as for the slabs they don't pose a problem yet because the map will probably be built on quite a lot, and it goes well with the design and can make it less flat. I could make the slabs thicker so it isn't just 1 thick, and it adds variation, or I could just make them double slabs... but I'd like more feedback for that ^^

replies.author: _DISTRACTION_
replies.body:
You say you put defense supplies in the spawn, yet I see no place to use them. There are no wool lanes; placing any kind of defense supplies would be futile considering the wool rooms are past an amount of void.

The middle of the map is very simplistic. This may not be much of an issue, but it will make the action there less interesting.

Having the map be shallow in order to prevent tunneling (people will still tunnel, by the way) is an interesting concept. It may work out, or it could unnecessarily push people to create skybridges.

In terms of the general feel of the map, this looks to me like what one would create if they saw old Avicus DTM maps and tried to create a CTW very similar to them. In my opinion, this is an unfavorable direction for CTW (in terms of gameplay and layout), and this map is a bad example for other CTW map-makers. This style should not become a trend.

replies.author: _DISTRACTION_
replies.body:
Keep in mind that what I said, was simply speculation based on what I have seen before. We will see how this map plays during the testing event; if it plays well, I will be a bit surprised but I will also accept it.

I have never doubted Vice's mapmaking skills; he has made very good CTW maps such as Deadlock and Revolution, and I'm not really too offended by the whole crop argument.

I guess I can say that this map's block pallete looks pretty nice. I like the general atmosphere (although it is a bit flat).
